content.user_title: Find Lark Meeting Records and Notes
content.value_statement: Teams lose time searching for past meeting records and follow-up details. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code find Lark meeting notes, transcripts, and action items.
actual_capabilities: Search ended Lark video meeting records by keyword, date range, organizer, participant, or room.
Retrieve note, transcript, and shared document tokens for completed meetings.
Guide users to the correct smart note or transcript source based on intent.
Fetch meeting summaries, action items, chapters, and transcript artifacts when authorized.
Handle pagination guidance for larger historical meeting searches.
limitations: Requires lark-cli authentication and the required Lark permission scopes.
Search is for ended meetings only, not future calendar events.
Cannot access notes when the user lacks meeting or document permission.
Transcript and media downloads may create local artifact files.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Follow-Up Summary
use_cases.description: Find a completed meeting and collect its smart note, summary, and action items for follow-up.

use_cases.title: Review Discussion History
use_cases.description: Search past meetings by participant, organizer, room, or date to understand prior decisions.

use_cases.title: Collect Meeting Evidence
use_cases.description: Retrieve transcript links and related document tokens for authorized review and documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Find Recent Meetings
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search by date or keyword.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find my ended Lark meetings from yesterday that mention the product launch.

prompt_templates.title: Get Meeting Notes
prompt_templates.scenario: Retrieve notes after selecting a meeting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this meeting ID to get the smart note link, transcript link, and shared document links.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Follow-Up Items
prompt_templates.prompt: For this meeting note, summarize the decisions, action items, owners, and due dates.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Meeting Series
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced search with pagination and filters.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search all ended weekly planning meetings this month, include every page, and compare recurring action items.

output_examples.input: Find meetings from last week that mention the onboarding plan.
output_examples.output: A short list of matching ended meetings with title, time, organizer, meeting ID, and next steps.

output_examples.input: Get notes for this meeting ID.
output_examples.output: Smart note and transcript links, available shared documents, and a reminder about required access permissions.

output_examples.input: Summarize the action items from this meeting note.
output_examples.output: A concise follow-up list with tasks, owners, due dates when present, and unresolved questions.

best_practices: Use at least one filter when searching meeting records.
Confirm user intent before reading full transcripts or note content.
Use pagination tokens until all requested results are collected.
anti_patterns: Do not use video meeting search for future calendar events.
Do not fetch full note content when links are enough.
Do not assume permission errors mean the meeting does not exist.

faq.question: What does this skill search?
faq.answer: It searches ended Lark video meeting records and helps retrieve related notes and transcripts.

faq.question: Can it find future meetings?
faq.answer: No. Future meetings should be handled by a calendar skill, not this video meeting skill.

faq.question: Does it require Lark access?
faq.answer: Yes. The user must authenticate lark-cli and have the required Lark permission scopes.

faq.question: Can it read full transcripts?
faq.answer: Yes, when the user asks for transcripts and has permission to access them.

faq.question: Will it change meeting data?
faq.answer: The documented workflows are read-only and focus on search, notes, metadata, and artifacts.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide a keyword, date range, meeting ID, minute token, organizer, participant, or room filter.
